assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
The patient has documented symptoms of palpitations (R00.2).
The patient has documented symptoms of dizziness (R42).
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptomatic episodes against the known mitral valve insufficiency.
